auto_improvement_loop.selection_method: Each candidate must clear its type-specific sample and ROI-edge hurdle in every available prior fold. Selection uses no validation-fold outcomes; baseline is the fallback.
auto_improvement_loop.promotion_policy: No model is automatically promoted from a single fold. Require repeated next-fold gains, adequate samples, and independent market-odds validation before production use.

validation.method: three rolling-origin folds with non-overlapping test windows; weights frozen within each test window; prior results added only after all races on a date are scored; market-value bets use timestamped official pre-off odds snapshots

recent_history_comparison._method: Same chronological holdout races and same trained weights; before excludes each horse's last-five-run form/venue/distance inputs, after includes them. Sire, jockey and age features remain identical.

validation.selection_rule: Each fold uses only strictly earlier training data; test weights remain fixed and race results are added to history only after the entire date is scored.

pace_feature_note: Experimental trained_with_pace model is holdout-only; production weights remain unchanged until validation passes.
prediction_policy: Scores use only races strictly earlier than the target race date; current-race finish/popularity/payout are excluded. All races on a date are predicted before any results from that date update the model.
